prompt: Which IIT (Indian Institute of Technology) in India installed the first supercomputer under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM)?
answer: The first supercomputer under India’s National Supercomputing Mission, **PARAM Shivay**, was installed at **IIT (BHU), Varanasi**.
